## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text is [鳩摩羅什](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%B3%A9%E6%91%A9%E7%BE%85%E4%BB%80) Kumārajīva's translation of the *Sumati-paripṛcchā*, parallel to [Zhú Fǎhù's T0334](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0026) and [Bodhiruci's T0336](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0028). The triple parallel-translation tradition documents the early-medieval Chinese reception of the bodhisattva-girl Sumati narrative.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [鳩摩羅什](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%B3%A9%E6%91%A9%E7%BE%85%E4%BB%80) Kumārajīva's Cháng'ān period (402 – 412 CE). The Taishō text (T0335) is established on the standard apparatus.
